_about: Batch B2a (Engine front). Owner: the B2a writer. Terms for the engine client, the engine core clients and the output path of the front end.

engine-client.short: The abstract class that the API server talks to (vllm/engine/protocol.py). AsyncLLM implements it: generate(), abort(), health checks, sleep and RPCs.
engine-client.long: The serving classes get the renderer and the input processor from it too ({{cite vllm/entrypoints/generate/base/serving.py:150-151}}).

mp-client.short: The base class of the engine core clients that talk to engine core processes over ZMQ. It binds (or takes over) the sockets, waits for the ready messages and, when it started the engine processes, watches them.

output-handler.short: The one background asyncio task of AsyncLLM. It takes EngineCoreOutputs from the engine core client, runs the OutputProcessor and puts each RequestOutput into the collector of its request.

request-state.short: The front-end record of one request in the OutputProcessor: prompt, detokenizer, logprobs processor, output kind, collector queue and timing stats.

utility-call.short: A remote method call from the front end to the engine core: a UTILITY message with a call id, a method name and arguments. The reply comes back in EngineCoreOutputs.utility_output.

engine-dead-error.short: The exception that the front end raises when an engine core process has died. It cannot be recovered; the API server then shuts down unless VLLM_KEEP_ALIVE_ON_ENGINE_DEATH is set.

dp-coordinator.short: An extra process for data parallel serving (MoE, or internal/hybrid load balancing). It collects load counts from the engine cores and publishes them to the API servers. For MoE it also tracks the request waves.
